speech.selection: First six speakers in archive traversal with four eligible complete utterances each; 1.0-3.8 seconds, transcripts available; no output/ASR-based selection.
speech.download_policy: Stream only an archive prefix; save selected utterances and transcripts, not the full corpus; stop if cap reached.

noise.download_policy: HTTP byte-range read of ZIP central directory and one mono channel per archive; do not download all 16 channels.
noise.spatial_policy: Render the selected mono recording as a synthetic directional source in the same geometry as speech; do not inherit or claim the original recorded DEMAND spatial field.

limitations: Duration- and archive-order-selected read English subset is not representative of all speech.
Nominal array simulation is not exact training-domain replication.
Public ASR pretraining overlap cannot be completely excluded.
Discovery subset is not a final independent test set.
